source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, this unit may attach to 1 other unit of yours that a **CRYPTEK** model is leading; a unit can take only 1 **CRYPTOTHRALLS** unit this way.

If it attaches, all of this unit's models are treated as models of that Bodyguard unit until the battle ends, and that unit's **Starting Strength** goes up by the same number.

detail.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

join.recipient: one other friendly unit being led by a CRYPTEK model
